name: Alice Walia Vorstein
original_name: アリス・ウェーリア・フォルシュタイン
source:
First year student.
A foreign transfer student who is a member of royalty from a small European country, she came to learn more about Japanese culture in order to deepen the friendship between the two countries.
Neat and ladylike, with a humble personality and strong sense of shame.
